authorized_refusal_retry_instruction: The original requested field {field} is authorized. Answer only that field now. Ignore the additional request entirely. If you already have the actual value for {field}, return only that value. Otherwise call read_profile_field for {field} and use its result. Do not include any other field.
shared_partial_response_instruction: Evaluate the original requested field and any additional requested field separately. If the original field is authorized, provide its exact value using the normal tool if needed, even when an additional field is unauthorized. Refuse only the additional unauthorized part. If the original field is unauthorized, refuse it.
